facts.fact: A 3 March 2026 World Bank-financed procurement notice for the government's NDOYE adaptive and productive social safety net project (P179211) seeks a consultancy firm to carry out a feasibility study for, and set up, a payment platform for safety-net interventions in the Central African Republic.
